screens.name: Hourly sweep
screens.description: Runs every hour under LOCK.lifecycle. Does nothing at all — and claims nothing — if RESEND_API_KEY is unset, so the day the key arrives everyone still eligible gets their mail.

elements.label: Every hour · one process at a time
Claim first, then send. A crash loses one mail, never loops.

screens.description: 1 to 48 hours after signing up. The 48h ceiling stops a deploy greeting every account ever created.

screens.name: Stalled on day 2
screens.description: 2 to 4 days after signup and they have never signed in. Gives one concrete sentence to type, because 'type anything' is exactly what a stalled person cannot do.

screens.name: Trial used up
screens.description: On the trial plan and spend has reached the cap. The first sentence is checkAccess's refusal copy verbatim, so the app and the inbox cannot drift apart.

screens.name: Machine put away
screens.description: Every minute the reaper stops idle or expired machines. If the person has no push notification set up, they get an email instead.

elements.label: Machine idle or expired → stopped

screens.description: Stripe reports a failed charge. Stripe retries on its own; if the card is never updated the plan pauses at period end.

screens.description: At most once a week per person, so Stripe's retries do not become four emails.

screens.description: Sent by Richy, one edition at a time, always tested to one address first. Each edition reaches each person once.
